title: Maximum Score Of Spliced Array
description: Maximize the sum of one array after swapping a subarray with the other array.
pseudocode:
1. diff = []
2. for i in range(len(nums1)): diff.append(nums1[i] - nums2[i])
3. max_diff = kadane(diff)
4. return max(sum(nums1) - max_diff, sum(nums2) + max_diff)

steps.note: Initialize difference array diff where diff[i] = nums1[i] - nums2[i]. nums1=[10, 5], nums2=[2, 8]
Running Kadane's on diff to find the maximum subarray sum.
Kadane's update: max subarray sum found is 8.
Calculate final score: max(sum(nums1) - 8, sum(nums2) + 8). Result: 13.
